description: This file defines the GeoZone model class for the OpenCart admin module, managing CRUD operations and data retrieval for geographical zones in the system.

classes.name: GeoZone
classes.description: Model class for handling geographic zones, including CRUD operations, zone associations, and caching.

methods.name: addGeoZone
methods.description: Creates a new geo zone record and associates zones if provided.

methods.name: editGeoZone
methods.description: Updates an existing geo zone record and its zone associations.

methods.name: deleteGeoZone
methods.description: Deletes a geo zone and its associated zones from the database.

methods.name: getGeoZone
methods.description: Retrieves a specific geo zone record by ID.

methods.name: getGeoZones
methods.description: Retrieves a list of geo zones with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalGeoZones
methods.description: Returns the total count of geo zones.

methods.name: addZone
methods.description: Associates a zone with a geo zone.

methods.name: deleteZones
methods.description: Removes all zone associations for a given geo zone.

methods.name: getZone
methods.description: Retrieves a specific zone to geo zone record by its ID.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Retrieves zone associations for a specific geo zone or all if ID is zero.

methods.name: getZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Retrieves all zone associations for a specific country ID.

methods.name: getTotalZones
methods.description: Returns the count of zone associations for a specific geo zone.

methods.name: getTotalZoneToGeoZoneByCountryId
methods.description: Returns the total number of zone-to-geo zone relations for a given country ID.

methods.name: getTotalZoneToGeoZoneByZoneId
methods.description: Returns the total number of zone-to-geo zone relations for a given zone ID.
